label: Zoho webhook events
description: Webhook calls received from Zoho. The zoho-webhook function stores each call; the webhook-event function processes it.

source.description: Zoho module the call came from, e.g. inventory_adjustment, shipmentorder

body.description: The request body as received (JSON or form data)

note.description: What processing did, or why the call was ignored

pending_item_ids.description: Zoho items still to refresh when a run stopped at its time budget

attempts.description: Times the maintenance job retried this call
